note: The neouterwall kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). The host's ground layers (47-host-land.js): ground.grass (ground.grass.lush: the wet meadow, the base, tinted by season), ground.moss (ground.moss001: the grove's and the wooded slopes' floor), ground.gravel (ground.gravel019: the shore, the talus), rock.wall (rock.megabreccia: the cauldron's wall, read from the side on the steep, KSTRATA's megabreccia blocks over it; a STAND-IN for the skarn, owed: core/materials/PROMPTS-NEEDED.md), ground.sinter (the springs' silica crust and the stair), ground.tundra (the rim's slopes over the tree line), ground.mat (ground.mat.thermal: the thermophile mats on the run-off). rock.dike (rock.basalt.polygonal: the dikes' fins). The cauldron's own plants (50-biome-neow-cauldron.js): frond (card.treefern), reed (card.reed), bark.fern (bark.mossy: the tree fern's root mantle). The conifers and the floor are the NW outer wall's, read in place with its own pack (build.py). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/neouterwall after any change, then python3 build.py.
